name: Lemon Pie No. 3
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: the juice and grated rind of a fresh lemon
ingredients.originalText: the juice and grated rind of a fresh lemon

instructions.text: Moisten a heaping tablespoonful of cornstarch with a little cold water
Add a cupful of boiling water
Stir over the fire till it boils and cook the cornstarch, say two or three minutes
Add a teaspoonful of butter and a cupful of sugar
Take off the fire and, when slightly cooled, add an egg well beaten and the juice and grated rind of a fresh lemon

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Moisten a heaping tablespoonful of cornstarch with a little cold water
2. Add a cupful of boiling water
3. Stir over the fire till it boils and cook the cornstarch, say two or three minutes
4. Add a teaspoonful of butter and a cupful of sugar
5. Take off the fire and, when slightly cooled, add an egg well beaten and the juice and grated rind of a fresh lemon
6. Bake with a crust
